text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp.
Just as we finished training and were about to grab lunch—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
I still have to keep going...!
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you take a break soon, though...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's fine... I'm okay. More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
New record, 5 seconds to the ideal time.
—Continuing training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Please, Onii-sama.
Just one more time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Please, Onee-sama.
Just one more time.
And as I saw Rice Shower off...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah! Rice-chan left!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Too baaad!
And here I thought I'd finally get to talk to you!"

(—Her name is Haru Urara.
Beloved by all for her innocent and cheerful nature,
she is also one of Rice Shower's friends.)
choice_data_list: So you wanted to talk with Rice Shower?
Did you want to talk with Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! There's so, so much
I want to talk about!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"So next time you see Rice-chan,
make sure to shout and let Urara know!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that so?
Then I'll just wait right here!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum-hum~♪
Urara-ra-ra~n♪
choice_data_list: ...By the way, what did you want to talk about?
...By the way, what were you planning to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"That's obvious!
Like asking to eat together..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Like telling them they're doing a great job, for example!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was whispering about it too!
They said Rice-chan's been working super hard
lately and looks totally cool!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fufun! Rice-chan, all of us are your cheer squad, you know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Why is Rice-chan's
Trainer here...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever!
You're veeery welcome!!

And together with Haru Urara,
I continued waiting for Rice Shower—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Urara...-chan?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Rice-chan!
Well then, let's head out together♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh!? Wh-Where did the two of you go...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Grilled carrots and yakisoba.
Stamina bowls, and an extra-large candied apple...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, what are you gonna eat first, Rice-chan?
As for me, carrot ice creeeam♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Rice... ugh~.
Which one should I choose... Big Brother...!
choice_data_list: Eat It All With Guts! Giant Candy Apple

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Rice... ugh~.
Which one should I choose... Big Sister...!
choice_data_list: Eat It All With Guts! Giant Candy Apple

text_block_list.text: (Nghh...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Hyawa!? Auuu~..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother... How did you know that Rice was super hungry?
choice_data_list: You worked so hard today, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister... How did you know Rice was super duper hungry?
choice_data_list: You worked so hard today, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I see. Big Brother,
you've always been watching over Rice, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I see. Big Sister,
you've always been watching over Rice, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Me too, me too!
I'm watching Rice-chan all the time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right.
...Thanks, Urara-chan.
And so the three of them enjoyed a pleasant meal together, savoring a brief, peaceful moment.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! A candy apple!
Can I really eat it!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, for Rice,
candied apples were a special reward.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I ran in a race or after taking a test,
my mother would always say, "You get a gold star today too."
choice_data_list: Then it's fine to eat some today.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. If it's Rice-chan, you can eat a hundred of them!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...D-Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! 'Cause she's working super,
suuuuuper hard!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you.
Big Brother, Urara-chan.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you.
Big Sister, Urara-chan.
And so the three of them enjoyed a pleasant meal together, savoring a brief, peaceful moment.
